content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-178. - I.R.C. Section R113.4, Violation penalties.
content.summary:
Section R113.4. Violation penalties,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
R113.4. Violation penalties.
Any violation of the residential code shall be punishable by a fine, or imprisonment,
                  or both, not to exceed the limits established in section 1-5."
